blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Sunday hit back at Vice President Sara Duterte over her claim that she no longer feels safe in the country, invoking the killings linked to her father’s bloody war on drugs and challenging her to testify on allegations involving her financial records. Palace Press Officer Claire Castro accused the Vice President of twisting the narrative to attack the Marcos administration, saying Filipinos had more reason to fear going out during the administration of former President Rodrigo Duterte because they could become victims of extrajudicial killings (EJKs). “Mas takot ang mga Pilipino noon na lumabas dahil pag nakursunadahan, […]...
